curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can a lone martial artist successfully reclaim his community's sacred relic from a ruthless criminal syndicate?
curatedMovie.description: After a sacred statue head is stolen from his village, a young martial artist enters the big city to retrieve it.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, kinetic, and suspenseful. An energetic martial-arts crime thriller best experienced with full attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This action-crime thriller follows a martial artist taking on the underworld to recover a village’s sacred relic.
